iterationHistory: Initial full suite passed 382 unit/45 E2E tests. Exported native/3x frames then exposed an ankle connection gap that those checks did not catch.

The final fix adds a bounded source-owned ankle allowance, explicit preservation during mesh preparation, and sole registration at y239. Added topology and metadata checks; reran the complete suite: 389 unit/45 E2E.

Review script initially expected only anchor x/y, omitting the exported units/origin fields. Its assertion was corrected to the complete schema. Native captions were wrapped. Final capture/render and source hashes were refreshed after these evidence-only edits.

visualReview.reviewed: Actual application exports at native and integer zoom, matched ankle crops, three expressions, recolor and complete playback checks. Separate from automated functional pass.
findings: Crossed clothing preserves identity and full expression heads.
Waist and moving-arm ownership remain coherent. Fixed blue underskirt is retained.
The detached-shoe gap is closed in the delivered four-action combinations without changing old skin output.
limits: Preserved crop head has a tiny pale collar edge visible with an open soft-top neckline.
Existing texture compression at deep knee bends and differences in source painting density remain.
Generated artwork requires registered parts/material masks; arbitrary whole-character images are not automatically split or retargeted.
Production Gathria integration and user aesthetic acceptance are unverified.
